# Aegis Space Domain Intelligence

> Aegis is an open-source, autonomous space traffic coordination platform designed for commercial satellite fleet collision avoidance and orbital conjunction arbitration.

## Overview
- Platform URL: https://aegis-orbital.app
- Documentation: https://aegis-orbital.app/docs
- Package Registry: aegis-sovereign-cli on NPM

## Core Technical Features
- Autonomous multi-agent AI judicial court arbitration (Chief Justice + Democratic Jurors)
- Zero-Knowledge telemetry architecture ensuring private operator parameters never leave local Sovereign Nodes
- Hardware-encrypted Trusted Execution Environment (TEE) enclave execution
- Real-time space catalog telemetry integration and 3D evasive burn calculations
